SecurityConfig - Class in com.irurueta.authserver.resourceserver.api.web.security
Secures the API: every request except the health endpoint and the OpenAPI document requires a valid bearer token issued by the authorization server for this resource server's audience.
SecurityConfig() - Constructor for class com.irurueta.authserver.resourceserver.api.web.security.SecurityConfig
 
stepUpAccessDeniedHandler(StepUpProperties) - Method in class com.irurueta.authserver.resourceserver.api.web.security.SecurityConfig
Builds the handler that answers the step-up requirement with the RFC 9470 challenge and every other denial with the RFC 6750 one.
StepUpAccessDeniedHandler - Class in com.irurueta.authserver.resourceserver.api.web.security
Answers a StepUpRequiredDecision with 401 and the RFC 9470 challenge (error="insufficient_user_authentication" with the required acr_values and max_age); every other denial goes to the delegate, the RFC 6750 handler.
StepUpAccessDeniedHandler() - Constructor for class com.irurueta.authserver.resourceserver.api.web.security.StepUpAccessDeniedHandler
 
stepUpAuthorizationManager(StepUpProperties) - Method in class com.irurueta.authserver.resourceserver.api.web.security.SecurityConfig
Builds the manager that requires a recent strong authentication to delete a document.
StepUpAuthorizationManager - Class in com.irurueta.authserver.resourceserver.api.web.security
Requires that the bearer token proves a recent strong authentication (RFC 9470): its acr claim must be one of the configured (space-separated) values and its auth_time claim no older than the configured maximum age.
StepUpAuthorizationManager() - Constructor for class com.irurueta.authserver.resourceserver.api.web.security.StepUpAuthorizationManager
